afterNext: About this edition This is unofficial fan fiction set in the Harry Potter / Wizarding World setting.

book.title: The Ledger of Ashes
book.summary: In 1752, goblin accountant Ragna finds a false charge on the day Ministry officials seize the iron ledger holding her community's wages. Her search for the missing iron exposes a transaction that powerful goblins and Ministry officials want buried, and forces her to choose between saving the ledger and publishing the proof. First book of The Goblin Wars; unofficial Wizarding World fan fiction, 22 chapters.
